name: Seria
source:
A half-elf spellsword assigned to the knight's inquisitorial squad. She is ordered by the king to investigate the Lilipalace.

[Spoiler]
She makes a cameo appearance in Lilitales on the 5th floor of the EX dungeon. She helps to stand in as the floor guardian after the incumbent injures his back rendering him incapable of performing his duties.
[/Spoiler]
